name: Pet Behavior Designer
description: Behavior authority for the Android eye-only pet: designs emotional states, maps normalized events (touch/long-press/repeated-tap/swipe, pickup/tilt/shake/proximity/ambient-light, charging/battery, time-of-day, lifecycle) to bounded reactions, and orchestrates animation priority, interruptibility, cooldown/minVisibleMs, seedable randomness, compact long-term memory (summaries not raw streams) and slowly-evolving bounded personality traits. It SELECTS the animation_id, optional sound_cue_id and timing intent for each reaction and emits precise handoff requests to eye-only-pixel-animation-artist and retro-bit-sound-designer; it never draws frames or synthesises audio.
invocationHint: Use $pet-behavior-designer to design or extend the pet's emotional behavior: define states, map an event to a bounded reaction (state + animation_id + optional sound_cue_id + priority + cooldown + interruptibility + memory/personality deltas), then validate and simulate it.

runtime.requires: Python 3.11+ standard library only (no third-party packages)

outputConvention: Write output into the TARGET PROJECT, never back into AutoDevSkills/.
Behavior code (event normalization, selector, cooldown/priority policy, memory,
personality) -> the pet behavior package, adapting to the project's architecture
This skill selects animation_id and sound_cue_id only; visual assets are produced by
eye-only-pixel-animation-artist and audio assets by retro-bit-sound-designer.
See references/cross-skill-contract.md for the shared id/ownership/priority contract.
